Sub: Proposals for grant_of exemption from EDLi Scheme 1976 and extension

Ref: (i) Co-ord.2 (2)2002/Amend./Pt/4827 dated 14" June 2005.

(ii) No. CPFC/Exem/SZ/2005 Vol.11/14750 dated 21-10-2007.
(ii) No. CPFC/Exem/SZ/2005 Vol.11/1947 dated 23-5-2008

Sir,

Your kind attention is invited to Hars. circular dated 14°" June 2005 regarding
revised procedure for processing applications seeking grant of exemption from EDLI
Scheme, 1976 u/s 17(12A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952. In this regard a further
communication was issued based on the review of trend of receipt of composite proposals
sent to Headquarters by Zonal Addl. CPFCs during the year 2006-07 vide letter of even
No. dated 21-10-2007. As the trend had not improved, a further circular was issued by
Addl. CPFC(Compliance) vide letter dated 23.05.2008 imploring upon all the Zonal Addl.
PFCs to conduct a general review in respect of establishments in the region under their
jurisdiction and send report to Headquarters on the points therein and with an advice to
adhere to the guidelines for processing applications for. grant of exemption or extension of
exemption as conveyed vide Head Office Circular No. C_Ili/Misc /ELVExem/EZ/22893-
22943 dated 24-7-2007.

2. The matter was reviewed and It is regretted to note that the same trend of receipt of
proposals to headquarters has continued till the month of February 2009. The proposals
have been regularly received from the office of Addl. CPFC, SZ but the situation has not
improved in so far as the regions located in North Zone, West Zone and East Zone is
concerned. The proposals which were due for further extension and the fresh proposals
both require to be looked into, otherwise such establishments may become liable for other
actions under the Act and Scheme. As a part of restructuring of field offices, the office of
Addl. CPFCs have been increased with revised jurisdiction over two political states. Under
the new dispensation, it is expected that the monitoring of such proposals in the regions
will show further improvement. Accordingly, all Addl. CPFCs may conduct a general
‘eview in respect of establishments in the Regions under their jurisdiction and send their
reports to headquarters as-already informed vide letter dated 23-05-2008 by 31.03.2009.

Yours faithfully,

( K. CHANDRAMOUL})
